content.text:
Submitted successfully.

**Repair made:** the parenthetical that interrupted the statutory phrase is gone. §21.1(a) now reads as a contiguous "the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms, including subscription fees, in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000" — so the basis is unambiguously "fees paid or payable", never broader "all amounts paid or payable", with the preferred claim-anchored lookback and the USD 1,000,000 floor.

**Still intact:** the "first Order Form" limiter is removed and lowercase "fees" plus the subscription-fees clarifier prevent the §1.5 definition (one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) from re-creating an illusory cap. Mutuality, §21.2's mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, §21.3's Excluded Claims and the payment-obligation carve-out are untouched and mapped as already_met with verbatim quotes. Single replace; minimality validated ok:true.
